location_exception_reason: MS Bunkhouses are industrial/construction equipment sold nationwide; location of manufacture or seller does not alter product function or buyer decision-making. No GI protection or regional origin significance.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'MS Bunkhouse Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title.
